title: Support picture in the img complete getter steps
body: Solves: https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9346 The HTMLImageElement complete getter steps currently return true if the `src` and `srcset` attributes are omitted from the `img` element, regardless of any parent picture element and sibling source elements. As a result, the complete getter steps return true, even though there might be a current request with a state of `Unavailable` or `Partially available`. This will give an unexpected result for authors that have provided `source` elements for a `picture` element, but omitted `src` and `srcset` on the `img` element. This PR replaces the attribute based check with a check on the result of `selecting an image source`.
